Subject: Redwood + BridgePoint Summit session — demo window request

Hi Neha,

BridgePoint is confirmed for the joint Summit booth track on Aug 10. The marketplace team has asked us to lock a 30-minute co-sell demo slot (15 min demo + 15 min Q&A). Would Redwood be able to join the session and do a short technical walkthrough, focusing on Dedicated + Marketplace routing?

Preferred windows (PST):
- Aug 10, 10:30–11:00
- Aug 10, 14:00–14:30

If those don't work, we can be flexible in the morning. Also, AWS Marketplace rep will likely join — I'll loop them in after we confirm availability.

Quick asks: can you share a short runbook (2–3 items) for ops handoff and an internal dry-run 24–48 hours prior? We'll need a calendar invite to include AWS and our SI engineers.

Thanks — excited to co-present.

Best,
Anita Shah
Partner Lead | BridgePoint Systems

We can provide:
- A 1-page runbook (ops checklist) — I'll attach v1.
- Internal tech dry-run: we can do Aug 9, 09:00–09:30 PST or Aug 9, 16:00–16:30 PST; prefer the earlier slot.

Please confirm attendee emails for the invite and whether AWS Marketplace needs any special calendar attributes (e.g., external guest restrictions). Once you confirm, I'll send the calendar invite and attach a short deck.

Regards,
